assumptions.policy: simple schedule: solar surplus charge any period, grid charge only SOP; discharge only off/on-peak; no simultaneous charge/discharge per controller
assumptions.access: total-meter load access assumed; no real circuit eligibility established; all installed costs unknown
assumptions.pv: separate hypothetical DC size = 1.25 times AC cap; AC-coupled PV; no DC recovery above AC cap; hourly proxy spread evenly across meter rows
assumptions.shape: production_proxy follows existing rooftop, not measured south portable placement; delayed_2h is hypothetical west/delayed proxy, not irradiance model; shade_50pct and winter_80pct are assumed energy reductions
assumptions.interval: 15-minute gross import/export can reflect changes inside the interval. Offset-first allocation is a modeled assumption, not proof of simultaneous instantaneous flows.
assumptions.export_credit: credited grants canonical NEM to incremental meter exports. zero_credit removes credit for ALL incremental meter exports, including displaced existing rooftop exports. Existing baseline rooftop exports retain canonical credits unless a battery consumes them. Electron-origin and legal eligibility unknown.
assumptions.zero_export: perfect control curtails only new residual PV; existing rooftop exports remain. This is incremental zero-export, not whole-site zero-export; device/control feasibility unknown.
assumptions.controllers: supplied sequence shares remaining imports and both solar source accounts; no intentional battery export; new surplus charges first; both dispatch orders reported
assumptions.shared_ac: one stated aggregate AC cap includes all new PV AC plus battery discharge; larger separately connected home-storage scenarios use their individual power limits
assumptions.base_battery: 20% reserve, 85% RTE split symmetrically, 10W continuous AC standby; assumptions, not measured product behavior
assumptions.economics: 5% real discount, 1% annual savings decline, zero real tariff escalation; no replacement/subscription/maintenance cost assumed because quote unknown; ceilings before those costs
assumptions.equipment_price: $1399 per 1.92kWh unit from supplied issue snapshot, observation date 2026-10-22; equipment-only marginal illustration, not installed price or available-stock claim
assumptions.backup: constant-load conditional runtime only; known product/circuit surge limits absent; no existing Enphase outage production or solar recharge assumed
assumptions.bill_limitations: calendar-month model differs from statement windows; frozen rate vintage differs from historical bills; documented historical residual remains unexplained. NBC sums positive physical import minus physical export within each fifteen-minute interval. Actual bills support this basis; exact utility interval mapping, precision, and grouped rounding remain unresolved. Uncredited exports still enter physical NBC netting as a modeling assumption; compensation and interconnection eligibility remain separate unresolved questions. Absolute modeled bills are not actual bills.
assumptions.fixed_costs: electric daily charge unchanged; gas unchanged and excluded from electric model
assumptions.incentives: zero homeowner federal25D credit; other incentive/VPP eligibility and monetary backup value unknown

whole_home_or_multiday_backup.reason: Essential-circuit energy/startup records, transfer isolation, grid-forming compatibility and outage weather evidence absent.
